lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Have lived! I have lived here since 2019.

en.tip: For something that started in the past and continues, use the present perfect.
en.caption: Do you say “I live here since 2020.”? 😅 For something that started in the past and continues, use present perfect: “I have lived here since 2020.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
